Characteristics of the cohort at each step

Source: R/characteristics.R
as_characteristics_tibble.Rd

Summarises chosen variables (demographics, baseline measures) for the cohort at each step of a flow: a baseline-characteristics ("Table 1") table with one column per step, each describing the rows surviving up to and including that step. as_characteristics_tibble() is the data layer; as_characteristics_table() renders it; stack_cohorts() gives the per-step rows themselves for other summary-table packages.

Usage

as_characteristics_tibble(
  flow,
  vars,
  steps = NULL,
  excluded = FALSE,
  level = NULL,
  numeric = "mean_sd",
  missing = c("ifany", "always", "never"),
  digits = 1L,
  drop_randomise = TRUE,
  assessed_label = "Assessed for eligibility",
  missing_label = "Missing",
  wide = FALSE
)

Arguments

flow

A cf_flow object produced by apply_criteria().

vars

Character vector of column names to summarise.

steps

Optional step selectors (a vector or list); see the section "Steps". NULL (default) means every step.

excluded

Logical. FALSE (default) describes the cohort surviving each step; TRUE describes the rows removed at each step.

level

Optional hierarchy level name at which to count units; see the section "Hierarchy levels". Requires a flow built with a hierarchy.

numeric

How to summarise numeric variables: "mean_sd" (default), "median_iqr", or both.

missing

When to include the row counting NA values per variable: "ifany" (default) if any column has one, "always", or "never".

digits

Decimal places for means, SDs, medians, quartiles and percentages. Default 1.

drop_randomise

Logical. Omit randomise() steps when steps is NULL (default TRUE).

assessed_label

Heading for step 0, the starting data. Default "Assessed for eligibility".

missing_label

Label of the row counting NA values. Default "Missing".

wide

Logical. FALSE (default) returns the long form; TRUE pivots the columns to one per step for display.

Value

With wide = FALSE, a tibble with one row per variable, summary row and step, ordered by variable (in vars order), then summary row, then step column:

variable

Column name

level

Factor level, "Mean (SD)", "Median [IQR]", missing_label, or NA for a logical variable's single row

step

Step number (0 = starting data)

label

Step heading

n

Rows (or units, with level) in that step's column

count

Rows in the level, or missing; NA for numeric summaries

pct

count as a percentage of the non-missing values (of n for the missing row); NA where the denominator is zero

stat

Display text: "12 (6.0%)", "45.2 (14.8)", "45.0 [35.0, 56.0]"; NA when there is nothing to summarise

With wide = TRUE, variable and level followed by one character column per step, named "<heading> (n = <n>)", holding stat.

Steps

By default there is one column per step from 0 (the starting data) to the last step, omitting randomise() steps (see drop_randomise). Column k holds cohort(flow, step_number = k): the rows that passed steps 1 to k. steps restricts or reorders the columns. Each element is resolved like at in cohort(): a number is a step number (0 = starting data); a string is a step label if one matches, else a category, meaning its last step. Steps named in steps are never dropped, even randomise() steps.

With excluded = TRUE, column k instead holds the rows removed at step k (those of excluded() with cf_step == k): the usual supplementary table of excluded participants' characteristics. Step 0 removes nothing and cannot be selected.

A column's heading is the step label, or assessed_label for step 0. Repeated headings are made unique with " #<n>".

Summaries

How a variable is summarised depends on its type:

  • numeric: a "Mean (SD)" row and/or a "Median [IQR]" row (shown as median [Q1, Q3]), chosen with numeric.

  • factor: one row per level of the factor, in level order, whether or not the level occurs; n (%) of the non-missing values.

  • character: as a factor whose levels are the distinct values in the starting data, sorted.

  • logical: a single row (level is NA) counting TRUE; n (%) of the non-missing values.

Each variable also gets a missing_label row counting NA values, as a percentage of the column's n; missing controls when it appears. Dates and other types are not summarised: convert them first.

Hierarchy levels

When the flow was built with apply_criteria(hierarchy = ), rows are summarised unless level names one of the hierarchy's levels, in which case each unit at that level (each distinct, complete key) contributes once and n counts units. A row with an NA in the level's key is not a unit. Every variable must then be constant within each unit across the starting data; a variable that varies within a unit is an error, since there is no single value to summarise.

See also

as_characteristics_table() for a formatted table, stack_cohorts() for the per-step rows, as_attrition_tibble() for the attrition counts themselves.

Other reporting: as_attrition_table(), as_attrition_tibble(), as_characteristics_table(), as_consort_diagram(), save_consort_diagram()

Examples

dat  <- mock_parallel_rct(n_participants = 200, seed = 1)
crit <- cf_criteria() |>
  include(~ age >= 18, label = "Adults only") |>
  include(~ eligible_screen, label = "Passed screening") |>
  exclude(~ withdrew, label = "Withdrew consent")
flow <- apply_criteria(dat, crit, id = "participant_id")

as_characteristics_tibble(flow, vars = c("age", "sex"))
#> # A tibble: 20 × 8
#>    variable level      step label                        n count   pct stat     
#>    <chr>    <chr>     <int> <chr>                    <int> <int> <dbl> <chr>    
#>  1 age      Mean (SD)     0 Assessed for eligibility   200    NA  NA   44.6 (14…
#>  2 age      Mean (SD)     1 Adults only                184    NA  NA   45.7 (13…
#>  3 age      Mean (SD)     2 Passed screening           169    NA  NA   45.2 (13…
#>  4 age      Mean (SD)     3 Withdrew consent           162    NA  NA   45.5 (13…
#>  5 age      Missing       0 Assessed for eligibility   200    10   5   10 (5.0%)
#>  6 age      Missing       1 Adults only                184     0   0   0 (0.0%) 
#>  7 age      Missing       2 Passed screening           169     0   0   0 (0.0%) 
#>  8 age      Missing       3 Withdrew consent           162     0   0   0 (0.0%) 
#>  9 sex      F             0 Assessed for eligibility   200    97  48.5 97 (48.5…
#> 10 sex      F             1 Adults only                184    86  46.7 86 (46.7…
#> 11 sex      F             2 Passed screening           169    80  47.3 80 (47.3…
#> 12 sex      F             3 Withdrew consent           162    76  46.9 76 (46.9…
#> 13 sex      M             0 Assessed for eligibility   200    98  49   98 (49.0…
#> 14 sex      M             1 Adults only                184    93  50.5 93 (50.5…
#> 15 sex      M             2 Passed screening           169    85  50.3 85 (50.3…
#> 16 sex      M             3 Withdrew consent           162    82  50.6 82 (50.6…
#> 17 sex      O             0 Assessed for eligibility   200     5   2.5 5 (2.5%) 
#> 18 sex      O             1 Adults only                184     5   2.7 5 (2.7%) 
#> 19 sex      O             2 Passed screening           169     4   2.4 4 (2.4%) 
#> 20 sex      O             3 Withdrew consent           162     4   2.5 4 (2.5%) 
as_characteristics_tibble(flow, vars = c("age", "sex"), wide = TRUE)
#> # A tibble: 5 × 6
#>   variable level     `Assessed for eligibility (n = 200)` Adults only (n = 184…¹
#>   <chr>    <chr>     <chr>                                <chr>                 
#> 1 age      Mean (SD) 44.6 (14.7)                          45.7 (13.6)           
#> 2 age      Missing   10 (5.0%)                            0 (0.0%)              
#> 3 sex      F         97 (48.5%)                           86 (46.7%)            
#> 4 sex      M         98 (49.0%)                           93 (50.5%)            
#> 5 sex      O         5 (2.5%)                             5 (2.7%)              
#> # ℹ abbreviated name: ¹​`Adults only (n = 184)`
#> # ℹ 2 more variables: `Passed screening (n = 169)` <chr>,
#> #   `Withdrew consent (n = 162)` <chr>

# Who was removed at each step?
as_characteristics_tibble(flow, vars = "age", excluded = TRUE, wide = TRUE)
#> # A tibble: 2 × 5
#>   variable level     `Adults only (n = 16)` `Passed screening (n = 15)`
#>   <chr>    <chr>     <chr>                  <chr>                      
#> 1 age      Mean (SD) 11.2 (4.0)             51.6 (13.7)                
#> 2 age      Missing   10 (62.5%)             0 (0.0%)                   
#> # ℹ 1 more variable: `Withdrew consent (n = 7)` <chr>

# Only the starting data and the final cohort, with both numeric summaries
as_characteristics_tibble(flow, vars = "age", steps = c(0, 3),
                          numeric = c("mean_sd", "median_iqr"), wide = TRUE)
#> # A tibble: 3 × 4
#>   variable level        Assessed for eligibility (n = 2…¹ Withdrew consent (n …²
#>   <chr>    <chr>        <chr>                             <chr>                 
#> 1 age      Mean (SD)    44.6 (14.7)                       45.5 (13.5)           
#> 2 age      Median [IQR] 43.5 [36.0, 53.8]                 44.0 [37.0, 53.8]     
#> 3 age      Missing      10 (5.0%)                         0 (0.0%)

#> #   ²​`Withdrew consent (n = 162)`
